outcome: size and wet weight of cell pellets
cohort: Human adipose-derived stem cells (hADSCs) collected from the abdominal subcutaneous tissue samples of patients undergoing caesarean section.
finding: 22(R)-hydroxycholesterol treatment significantly increased the size and wet weight of cell pellets, glycosaminoglycans production, and expression of chondrogenic-related genes compared to control and other oxysterols.
